editorial.headline: When Workplace Training Is the Business
editorial.standfirst: This activity covers company-run workplace training beyond the specifically defined training fields, from safety and career development to motivation and NLP.
editorial.body:
This activity is for companies that organise workplace training in fields not otherwise specified within the training classification. Its scope is broad but still practical: training methodology, occupational health and safety, motivation, personal development, career development, neuro-linguistic programming and other company-delivered work-training subjects all sit within its remit. The focus is not simply on teaching as an abstract pursuit, but on a business organising training as a commercial activity.

For founders, the important distinction is the character of the service. This is a vehicle for structured work-training programmes delivered by a company, whether the subject is professional capability, safety practice, personal advancement or career direction. The record does not state which business scales are open to this activity, so that point should not be assumed or embellished. What it does establish clearly is that the national PMA position is open, with foreign ownership permitted up to 100%.

Bali presents a more accommodating picture than the province’s broad PMA moratorium might initially suggest. That moratorium permanently blocks PMA registration for low- and medium-low-risk activities across the island. This activity, however, is recorded in Bali as medium-high or high risk and is not blocked by that moratorium. A foreign investor is therefore not barred from registering this activity in Bali on that basis.

That is not the same as treating the Bali position as automatic. The record specifically calls for verification by address, making the location of the intended operation a live part of the assessment. Nationally, the ownership ceiling is fully open at 100%; in Bali, the activity is not subject to the island-wide moratorium, but its medium-high or high-risk status means the address should be checked before founders regard the registration path as settled. The editorial lesson is simple: this is a broadly framed corporate-training activity with a nationally open PMA position and a Bali route that remains available, subject to the address-specific verification stated in the record.
